questionSnapshot.question: What color is Ariel's mermaid tail in the animated The Little Mermaid (1989)?

notes: Added film/version to avoid visual interpretation across remakes. Inspected Disney's film still and corroborating text. Four color options, easy. #54 Tinker Bell dress, #41 father, and #205 Belle dress are distinct attributes.

verification.context: Ariel's mermaid form in Disney's animated The Little Mermaid (1989), not the 2023 remake or promotional human dresses.

options.reason: Her tail is sea-green; the official still visibly shows its teal-green body.

sources.locator: Disney Princess Ariel Photos, first still, Flounder and Ariel swimming to the top of her grotto. Downloaded and visually inspected: teal-green tail body below lavender shells, red hair. Corroborated by Development section of the character reference.
Development: explicitly describes the 1989 film tail as sea-green and contrasts it with red hair. Secondary text used with directly inspected Disney film still; no unseen documentary claimed.

options.reason: Blue is not the described tail color; the character design distinguishes sea-green from other colors.
